title: Hold a liquor licence to sell alcohol
what: Hold a liquor licence (or permit) of the right type before selling or supplying alcohol; cafes and restaurants usually need an on-premises or restaurant licence.

sources.title: Liquor Licensing Act 1990 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not sell liquor except as authorized by– (a) a liquor licence; or (b) a liquor permit; or (c) a general liquor exemption.

reach.note: Businesses whose main activity is selling alcohol.
